judged_text: With sharing enabled refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but line 96 reads tokenInfo.data.error — a Response has no data property — throwing TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Zoho Bigin calendar operations crash on every token refresh for sharing-enabled deployments; the axios-response shape (tokenInfo.data) that the surrounding code requires only exists on the sharing-disabled path.

record.issue_text: [BUG] With sharing enabled refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but line 96 reads tokenInfo.data.error — a Response has no data property — throwing TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Zoho Bigin calendar operations crash on every token refresh for sharing-enabled deployments; the axios-response shape (tokenInfo.data) that the surrounding code requires only exists on the sharing-disabled path.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the function performs a `fetch(...)` and returns the raw Fetch `Response`. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token call was changed to `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(async () => await axios.post(...), "zoho-bigin", credentialId);` and immediately afterwards the code dereferences `tokenInfo.data.error` / `tokenInfo.data`. That `.data` shape exists for the axios path, but not for the sharing-enabled fetch-returned `Response`, so `tokenInfo.data` will be `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError in sharing-enabled deployments.
